rationale: This intentionally invalid fixture proves that the adapter selects no record shape for an unrecognized mode and therefore cannot silently infer an assessment form.
trust_boundary: No boundary is asserted by this negative fixture because an unknown mode is invalid before structural evidence can be interpreted as a CRA record.

alternatives.rejection_reason: This rejection text exists only to keep the fixture otherwise shaped like an assessment record while mode dispatch is the single intended invalid relation.
